title: NIDS study correlating triangle sightings to US naval bases

tellings.quote: Uh there's that famous NID study done in the I think late 90s or early 2000s where they correlate triangle sightings to naval bases in the United States.

plain: A study by NIDS, a private group that researched UFOs, is said to have matched reports of large triangular craft against the map and found they cluster around US naval bases. Matthew Brown, a former Pentagon official turned whistleblower, calls it "that famous" study and tells Michels it was done "I think late 90s or early 2000s," without naming the report or giving its findings in detail. If it holds, the link would point to the triangles being tied to the Navy.
